# Tripo’s Agentic Canvas makes the 3D workflow reusable


By OpenTools Team


Creators can inspect individual operations and apply a saved process across multiple assets.


##


A process to inspect


Tripo’s[November 2 release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/tripo-ai-unveils-agentic-canvas-to-make-ai-3d-more-accessible-and-scalable-302926715.html) describes Agentic Canvas as connected operations within Tripo Studio. Connections pass one operation’s output into a subsequent step. The agent can generate a workflow; users can inspect results and adjust individual nodes, including steps such as texturing or rigging.


##


What another asset reuses


The reusable object is the sequence of operations, rather than only a finished model.[Tripo says](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/tripo-ai-unveils-agentic-canvas-to-make-ai-3d-more-accessible-and-scalable-302926715.html) workflows can be saved, duplicated and applied across assets through batch processing. A creator can therefore start from an existing process instead of rebuilding every step. The AI 3D Lab node can also turn conversations into reusable task instructions.
